events.name: Equinar: Waking Dream
events.intro: Wild horses stand in a ring in a misty field, every one of them asleep on its feet, breathing slow together like one great animal. An old herder leans on the gate with her eyes half-closed, as if she is dreaming too. "They dream together when it's near," she says. "Equinar stirs, and its stage is open for a short time. Go quiet."

success.text: You climb the gate. The mist closes behind you like a curtain.
You leave it. Equinar goes on stirring, somewhere behind you, for a little while longer.

events.name: Waking Dream
events.intro: The mist is thick and warm. You walk past sleeping horses whose eyes move under their lids. One of them whinnies softly, dreaming, and every horse in the field twitches with it.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Equinar goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Waking Dream
events.intro: You find a dream lying on the grass: a pony, small and young, running and running across a field that is not there. Your team stops to watch it. It runs until it is gone.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Equinar goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Waking Dream
events.intro: The ring of horses tightens. In the middle there is a space just the size of something very large. The air there shimmers like heat, and smells of hay and rain.

success.text: You take one more step, and then you see it.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Equinar goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Equinar
events.intro: It is there. Equinar stands in the ring as if it was always there and you only now saw it, pale as the mist, its mane drifting like smoke. It looks at you, and the whole herd breathes in.

success.text: You step into the ring. Equinar lowers its head, not in anger, in welcome: a test, the oldest one.

win.text: You faced Equinar in its own stage.

success.text: You stay at the edge of the ring. Equinar walks through the herd, touching each sleeping horse with its nose, and each one wakes, calm, and lifts its head. When it passes your team they lean toward it, and something settles in them, a trust that was not quite there before.

effects.text: You watched Equinar from a distance, and it let you.

success.text: You back away to the gate. The mist lifts behind you, and in the wet grass by the gatepost there is a single white hair, long as your arm, that shines.

events.name: The Hollow Shepherd: Haunted Hour
events.intro: Dusk comes, and does not end. The light stays the colour of a bruise for an hour, then longer. On a hill a flock of Mareep lie down all at once, as if told to. A shepherd girl with a crook too tall for her stands very still among them. "It counts them," she whispers. "Every night. Don't stand in the flock. The Hollow Shepherd stirs, and its stage is open for a short time."

success.text: You step off the road, careful to keep to the edge of the flock.
You leave it. The Hollow Shepherd goes on stirring, somewhere behind you, for a little while longer.

events.name: Haunted Hour
events.intro: The grass is cold, colder than the evening. Somewhere a bell is ringing, very slowly, the way a bell rings when nobody is pulling the rope.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, the Hollow Shepherd goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Haunted Hour
events.intro: You pass a fence where someone has carved a tally, hundreds of marks, years of them. The newest mark is still pale. Your team presses close behind your legs.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, the Hollow Shepherd goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Haunted Hour
events.intro: The flock lies in a perfect circle on the hilltop. Every Mareep has its eyes open. None of them are afraid. They are waiting to be counted, and so, you realise, are you.

success.text: You take one more step, and then you see it.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, the Hollow Shepherd goes on stirring without you.

events.name: The Hollow Shepherd
events.intro: It comes up the hill without walking: a tall, thin shape with a lantern for a face and a crook of frost, moving from Mareep to Mareep, touching each one, counting. It reaches the edge of the flock, and it turns its lantern toward you.

success.text: You step into the flock. The Hollow Shepherd stops counting. The bell stops ringing. In the silence it raises its crook.

win.text: You faced the Hollow Shepherd in its own stage.

success.text: You stand very still. It counts the flock, and then, slowly, it counts your party too, one by one, touching each with the cold crook. It nods, as if the number is right. Your fallen ones feel lighter, as if somebody is keeping them safe until you can rest.

effects.text: You watched the Hollow Shepherd from a distance, and it let you.

success.text: You walk away without looking back. Dawn comes up all at once behind you, and the whole flock stands up, shaking dew off their wool, as if nothing at all had happened.

events.name: Brinecrown: Rising Tide
events.intro: The sea is rising with no wind at all, flat and silver, creeping up the beach. On the rocks someone has left a ring of crowns made of salt, white and glittering. A fisher is pulling his boat up past them, quick and quiet. "It's coming in to look at us," he says. "Brinecrown stirs, and its stage is open for a short time. I'm not stopping."

success.text: You walk out along the rocks while the water climbs.
You leave it. Brinecrown goes on stirring, somewhere behind you, for a little while longer.

events.name: Rising Tide
events.intro: The rocks are slick and the sea laps at your boots, warm as a bath. Little fish have come up into the pools to watch, as if something is about to happen.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Brinecrown goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Rising Tide
events.intro: A Wingull lands beside you and does not fly off. It looks out to sea, and so do you. Far out, the water is moving in a slow circle, wider than a town.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Brinecrown goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Rising Tide
events.intro: The tide reaches the ring of salt crowns and stops, exactly there, as if it knows. The circle out at sea is coming in. Your water-types are shaking with excitement.

success.text: You take one more step, and then you see it.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Brinecrown goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Brinecrown
events.intro: Brinecrown rises out of the circle like a ship surfacing: vast, blue-white, its head crowned in a ring of salt that drips and reforms. It looks along the shore, at the fisher's boat, at the crowns, and then at you.

success.text: You step down into the water. Brinecrown sees you come, and the whole sea lifts to meet it.

win.text: You faced Brinecrown in its own stage.

success.text: You sit on the rocks and do not move. Brinecrown circles once, close enough that the spray soaks you, and then it sinks away. The sea goes calm behind it, so calm the fisher shouts and pushes his boat back out, and offers to take you across for nothing.

effects.text: You watched Brinecrown from a distance, and it let you.

success.text: You climb back up the beach. The tide goes out after you, slowly, and takes the salt crowns with it, one by one.

events.name: Veinheart: Stone Hall
events.intro: A cave mouth in the hillside, and inside, a sound like a drum, slow and deep. You feel it in your teeth before you hear it. An old miner sits at the entrance with his helmet in his lap. "The hills have a pulse," he says. "That's it, that is. Veinheart stirs, and its stage is open for a short time. I've heard it once before, when I was a boy."

success.text: You duck under the lintel. The beating gets louder.
You leave it. Veinheart goes on stirring, somewhere behind you, for a little while longer.

events.name: Stone Hall
events.intro: The tunnel walls are warm. Every few seconds the rock under your hand gives a soft thump, like a heart under a shirt. Your rock-types lay their heads against it and close their eyes.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Veinheart goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Stone Hall
events.intro: You pass old tools left behind in a side passage: picks, a lamp, a child's shoe. Someone carved a name over them. It has been worn almost smooth by a hundred years of hands touching it.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Veinheart goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Stone Hall
events.intro: The tunnel opens into a hall so big your lamp does not reach the roof. The beating is everywhere now. A seam of ore runs through the walls in every direction, like veins, and they are all pulsing in time.

success.text: You take one more step, and then you see it.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Veinheart goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Veinheart
events.intro: In the middle of the hall the rock stands up. Veinheart is shaped like the hill itself: stone and iron, a great heart of ore glowing in its chest, beating. It turns toward your lamp.

success.text: You walk out into the hall. Veinheart's heart beats faster. The whole hill beats with it.

win.text: You faced Veinheart in its own stage.

success.text: You set your lamp down and wait. Veinheart shows itself, slowly, letting you see. The seam in the wall nearest you glows bright, and a chunk of it falls free at your feet: a stone as hard as the hill, and a ball of iron, still warm.

effects.text: You watched Veinheart from a distance, and it let you.

success.text: You turn and walk back toward the daylight. Behind you the beating slows, and slows, until the hill is quiet, and at peace.

events.name: Lumeria: Hive Mind
events.intro: Bug Pokémon are gathering in a glade at dusk: Volbeat, Illumise, Ledyba, more than you can count, glowing faintly and moving as one, the way a flock of birds moves. They turn together, and the glow ripples. Lumeria stirs, and its stage is open for a short time.

success.text: You step into the glade. The swarm parts around you, politely.
You leave it. Lumeria goes on stirring, somewhere behind you, for a little while longer.

events.name: Hive Mind
events.intro: The glow follows you between the trees, always just ahead, as if leading you. When you stop, it stops. When you go on, it goes on.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Lumeria goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Hive Mind
events.intro: You find a fallen log covered in sleeping Bug Pokémon, all glowing in time with each other, slow and steady, like breathing. Your bug-types settle beside them and start to glow too.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Lumeria goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Hive Mind
events.intro: The swarm is thicker here, a cloud of light. Then, all at once, every glow goes out. In the dark you can hear wings, thousands of them, holding perfectly still in the air.

success.text: You take one more step, and then you see it.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Lumeria goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Lumeria
events.intro: Lumeria lights up in the middle of the dark: small and bright and very old, with wings like stained glass. Every Bug in the glade lights up with it, at once, and the whole forest is day.

success.text: You step toward it. The swarm draws back into a great ring of light around you both, like a stadium.

win.text: You faced Lumeria in its own stage.

success.text: You stand at the edge of the light and watch. Lumeria hums, and the swarm streams out of the glade ahead of you, lighting every path and every hidden turn of the stage ahead, so that you can see where everything is.

effects.text: You watched Lumeria from a distance, and it let you.

success.text: You step back out of the glade. The glow fades behind you, one light at a time, until it is just a dark wood again, and very quiet.

events.name: Verdelis: Overgrowth
events.intro: A town whose walls have been overgrown overnight. Flowers push up through the paving. Vines hang from the shop signs. People stand in the street in their nightclothes, staring. A shopkeeper is trying to open her door through a curtain of ivy. "It's beautiful," she says. "It's also my shop." Verdelis stirs, and its stage is open for a short time.

success.text: You follow the trail of flowers into the green.
You leave it. Verdelis goes on stirring, somewhere behind you, for a little while longer.

events.name: Overgrowth
events.intro: The flowers grow as you watch, opening as you pass, closing behind you. Your grass-types walk with their faces turned up to them, the way they turn to the sun.

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Verdelis goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Overgrowth
events.intro: In a back garden an old man is crying, very quietly, over a tree that has burst into blossom. "My wife planted that," he tells you. "It never flowered. Not once in forty years."

success.text: You go on, deeper in.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Verdelis goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Overgrowth
events.intro: The square is a forest now. The fountain is a pond. A fawn of vines and flowers is drinking from it, and it looks up at you with bright, curious eyes.

success.text: You take one more step, and then you see it.
You sit for a moment and let your team catch their breath. Nothing hurries you here. Then you go on.
You keep what you carry and walk back the way you came. Behind you, Verdelis goes on stirring without you.

events.name: Verdelis
events.intro: Verdelis steps out from behind the fountain: delicate, green and gold, with petals for a mane and a trail of new grass wherever it treads. The whole town holds its breath.

success.text: You step forward into the square. Verdelis tilts its head, interested, and the grass at your feet grows tall and wild.

win.text: You faced Verdelis in its own stage.

success.text: You watch from the edge of the square. Verdelis walks to the very middle, and plants one tree there, with care, pressing the earth down with its hooves. Then it walks out of the town gate, and the vines go with it.

effects.text: You watched Verdelis from a distance, and it let you.

success.text: You turn to go. As you pass the shop, the vines pull back from the shopkeeper's door, politely, all by themselves. She laughs out loud.
